title: 静音车厢

lines.text: 李老师要去上海开会，坐早上的高铁，她特意买了静音车厢的票。

lines.py: zhǐ tiáo shàng xiě zhe: “xiè xie nǐ tí xǐng wǒ men. wǒ men zhè bèi zi dì yī cì zhè me ān jìng de lǚ yóu, tài hǎo wán le!”
lines.en: The note says: "Thank you for reminding us. It's the first time in our lives we've travelled so quietly, and it was such fun!"

lines.en: Only then does Teacher Li realise she hasn't changed a single word of her talk — though her table now has a pile of tangerine peel on it.
